title: Part 5
content_zh: Li Bai drank alone under the moon, raising his cup to invite the shadow. In his drunken state, the moon, his shadow, and Li Bai became three companions. Such was the genius of Tang poetry — it could make loneliness into a party.
content_en: Li Bai drank alone under the moon, raising his cup to invite the shadow. In his drunken state, the moon, his shadow, and Li Bai became three companions. Such was the genius of Tang poetry — it could make loneliness into a party.
